Remove all items, tags, and detachable parts

Open all pockets and shake out dirt

Dip brush/sponge and scrub gently (especially stains)

Avoid soaking the bag completely

Wipe with a clean damp cloth

Baking soda + water paste

Or white vinegar (spot test first)

✅ Hard-Shell Trolley Bag

You’ll need:
Dish soap, microfiber cloth, non-abrasive sponge

Wipe with soapy water

Remove scuff marks using:

Baking soda paste

Toothpaste (for light marks)

Rinse with clean damp cloth

Dry immediately

🧴 Step 4: Clean Interior

Wipe lining with mild soap water

Use disinfectant spray (optional)

Baking soda sachet

Charcoal pouch

Wheels: Remove hair/dirt; wipe with damp cloth

Zippers: Clean with toothbrush + soap

Lubricate zippers & wheels lightly with silicone spray or candle wax

Air dry completely in shade

Keep all compartments open
